scope_summary: Make opening balances, deposits, withdrawals, account fees, interest, received dividends, and paid-in-lieu dividends use positive input magnitude with type-derived ledger sign.
Require permanent owner-scoped idempotency for financial create and reversal commands, replay completed responses before mutable-state checks, and commit facts, postings, and responses atomically.
Replace transaction deletion with append-only compensating reversals and add linked dividend and opening-balance reversals carrying actor, reason, and request identity.
Enforce transaction immutability and position-event financial-field immutability in both the ORM and PostgreSQL/SQLite database layers.
Serialize account then position access for dividend commands, allocate lifecycle sequence under lock, and prevent duplicate or concurrent reversals.
Hard-delete only accounts that have never held a financial fact; permanently archive historical accounts, preserve read access and retries, and reject new financial writes.
Freeze account base currency under the same account lock used by first-fact and future ImportSession commands, including a PostgreSQL race regression.
Disable transfer and destructive transaction controls in the release API/UI and expose stable retry keys and reversal controls in the frontend.

fixed_findings.resolution: Account metadata updates now acquire the shared account lock and re-evaluate both the permanent hard-delete marker and persisted financial history; a PostgreSQL race test proves the update waits and fails frozen.

fixed_findings.resolution: A one-way hard_delete_eligible marker is backfilled from existing history and flipped by opening balance, transaction, dividend, and truth-native OPEN commands under the account lock.
